response.sql:
WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    s.healtheval,
    COUNT(*) as cnt,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () as share
  FROM scanconservation sc
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
avg_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_sh FROM grouped
)
SELECT
  AVG(g.cnt) as avg_count,
  AVG(g.share) as avg_share,
  AVG(g.share - av.avg_sh) as avg_excess
FROM grouped g
CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc av
WHERE g.share > av.avg_sh

assumptions.assumption: NULL healtheval values are treated as a distinct group (per 'Treat a missing status as its own group'), meaning they appear in GROUP BY and participate in the average-share calculation like any other status value.
'Above-average share' means each group's share exceeds the arithmetic mean of all groups' shares, calculated across all healtheval groups (including NULLs) from the inner-joined data.
